subject: Warning and internal check do not agree - mystery(?)

messages.author: 7a97c986864bf6d6
messages.subject: Warning and internal check do not agree - mystery(?)
parts:
Hello Community,

although I have an internal check on a parameter

if(min(to_row_vector(a))<0) print("ERROR!")

and nothing gets printed, I get warning at the end of the stan execution that 

validate transformed params: a[1] is -inf, but must be greater than or equal to 0             10
validate transformed params: a[11] is -0.0691766, but must be greater than or equal to 0       1
validate transformed params: a[13] is -0.14352, but must be greater than or equal to 0         1
validate transformed params: a[13] is -0.225535, but must be greater than or equal to 0        1
validate transformed params: a[1] is -1.54631e+18, but must be greater than or equal to 0

for some iterations.

Please help me to understand how to solve this mystery.

I attach code and data:


model='
data{
int N;
int P;
vector[P] slices;
vector[P] slices2;
vector[N] y[P];
}
parameters{
real<lower=0> cc1;
real<lower=0> aa2;
real<upper=sqrt(4*aa2*cc1)> aa1;
real<lower=0> bb2;
real bb1;
real<lower=0> cc2;

}
transformed parameters{
vector<lower=0>[P] a;
vector<lower=0>[P] b;

a = aa1 * slices + aa2 * slices2 + cc1;
b = bb1 * slices + bb2 * slices2 + cc2;
}
model{

if(min(to_row_vector(a))<0) print("ERROR!");

for(p in 1:P) target += gamma_lpdf(y[p] | a[p],b[p]);  
}
'

load("input_model.RData")
fit <- rstan:::stan(
  model_code=model,
  data = list(N=dim(df)[1], P=length(slices), y=t(df), slices=slices, slices2=slices^2),
  iter=500,
  seed=133
)

 



Thanks a lot!
